name: Mountain Strider (Racial)
body:
You are more nimble when in the mountains.

Prerequisite: Tengu, Mountain Tengu, Dex 13.

Benefit: When in mountainous terrain, you gain a +2 racial bonus to Acrobatics checks. Furthermore, your speed increases by 5 feet, even when moving through rough terrain. Thus, when moving through normal mountain terrain your speed is 3/4 your base speed + 5 feet, and when through trackless mountain terrain, you actually move at 1/2 speed + 5 feet.
